Hamstr 0.2.0 adds more ways to organize and download your files, and makes large libraries lighter to browse.

- Choose the download engine in Settings: yt-dlp or Cheek. This release bundles **Cheek 0.1.1**, with parallel HTTP chunks, HLS segments and static yt-dlp DASH fragment lists for video and audio.
- Add links from inside the app, import local files, browse playlist groups and search your library.
- Home screen widget and launcher shortcuts for adding links and opening the library.
- Fully revealed thumbnails skip hidden ASCII rendering work. Playlist grouping is more efficient and library filters and groups are reused during active download progress updates.
- Download-history writes run on a single background worker, coalesce rapid changes and use atomic file replacement.
- Thumbnail requests refresh when the requested size changes, and ASCII animation respects reduced motion.
- Correct player API declarations and Activity lookup.

Downloads remain on your device. `arm64-v8a` is the APK for most phones; `armeabi-v7a` supports older 32-bit devices, and `universal` includes every supported ABI. Existing installations can update through Settings → About. Verify APK downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
